name: FLUX.3 Klein distilled — fast text to image
description: Generate an image from a text prompt with Black Forest Labs' FLUX.3 Image Klein, distilled build: 16 steps and no guidance, so it is the quick one (about 8 s). Write full sentences: subject, action, setting, light, style; put any text to render in "quotes". FLUX.3 likes a detailed caption — if you would rather write a short idea, tick "Improve the prompt with AI" and a Qwen 3.5 model expands it first, but on this machine that adds about 3 minutes. Experimental.
author: Template - ComfyUI (FLUX.3 Image Klein)

exposedParameters.label: Prompt
exposedParameters.default: A cinematic, Dutch angle night shot of a retro hotel entrance illuminated by neon cyan and warm orange lights. A bellhop in uniform pulls a gold luggage cart with suitcases across a wet sidewalk. Inside the brightly lit, teal-toned glass lobby, two women in vintage uniforms stand near a wooden desk alongside tropical plants and a seated figure. The scene features a moody, stylized teal-and-orange color palette with strong neon reflections. Absolutely no text, no typography, no letters, no words, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no captions, pure imagery only.
